en: The image shows a vintage postcard featuring a public space with a prominent statue at the center, which stands on a pedestal surrounded by trees and trimmed hedges. Behind the statue, there is a large, elegant building visible in the background. The top of the postcard reads 'PASEO, ESTATUA DE MENDEZ-NUÑEZ.' The bottom left corner has 'VIGO' printed, indicating the city. There are two postal stamps—one circular and one oval—visible in the top right and bottom right corners, as well as printed attribution to 'EUGENIO KRÄPF, VIGO' on the left.
